sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报 DealBook 负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 在 11 月 18 日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访几位商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在 11 月 18 日在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download The New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望大家能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过它的。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是。

sentences.en: For years, Republicans have campaigned on gun rights, while Democrats running for office have avoided the gun issue altogether.
sentences.zh: 多年来，共和党人一直以枪支权利为竞选口号，而竞选公职的民主党人则完全避开枪支问题。

sentences.en: Will this year's midterms finally be about gun control?
sentences.zh: 今年的中期选举最终会围绕枪支管控展开吗？

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, February 28th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 2 月 28 日，星期三。

sentences.en: Tim Walls, a gun owner.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆·沃尔斯，一个枪支持有者。

sentences.en: He grew up hunting and spent 24 years in the Army National Guard.
sentences.zh: 他在狩猎中长大，并在陆军国民警卫队服役了 24 年。

sentences.en: Tim Walls is a House Democrat from southwestern Minnesota, a pretty rural district, and he was the sort of classic archetype of a rural Democrat.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆·沃尔斯是来自明尼苏达州西南部的一名众议院民主党人，那是一个相当乡村化的选区，他可以说是乡村民主党人的经典原型。

sentences.en: I'm Tim Walls.
sentences.zh: 我是蒂姆·沃尔斯。

sentences.en: You know, growing up, hunting taught me a lot about responsibility and respect, lessons I hope to pass on to my kids.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在成长过程中，狩猎教给我很多关于责任和尊重的道理，这些经验我希望能传授给我的孩子们。

sentences.en: Ran for Congress with pro-gun credentials.
sentences.zh: 带着支持枪支的资历竞选国会议员。

sentences.en: Jonathan Martin covers national politics for The Times.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森·马丁为《时报》报道国家政治。

sentences.en: Got money from the NRA and earned an A rating from the NRA.
sentences.zh: 从美国全国步枪协会（NRA）获得了资金，并获得了 NRA 的 A 级评价。

sentences.en: And so when you're in that district, this is a resume that really works pretty well.
sentences.zh: 因此，当你在那个选区时，这是一份效果相当不错的履历。

sentences.en: I'm proud to stand with the NRA to protect the rights of sportsmen and gun owners.
sentences.zh: 我很自豪能与 NRA 站在一起，保护运动员和枪支持有者的权利。

sentences.en: That's why I approve this message.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我批准这个信息。

sentences.en: Tim Walls.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆·沃尔斯。

sentences.en: He works for us.
sentences.zh: 他为我们工作。

sentences.en: Paid for by Walls for Congress.
sentences.zh: 由“沃尔斯竞选国会议员”委员会出资。

sentences.en: Now, though, he's running for governor.
sentences.zh: 不过现在，他正在竞选州长。

sentences.en: I imagine, Jonathan, that this is the kind of candidate that Democrats are looking for right now in this moment, particularly in red states and purple states.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，我想这就是民主党目前在此时此地寻找的那类候选人，特别是在红州和紫州。

sentences.en: Yeah, Democrats who lost the presidency because they fell short in a series of states in the
sentences.zh: 是的，那些因为在

sentences.en: industrial Midwest are now looking for a political comeback, a sort of path back to relevance.
sentences.zh: 工业中西部的一系列州表现不佳而失去总统宝座的民主党人，现在正寻求政治卷土重来，寻找一条重返影响力的道路。

sentences.en: And you've got somebody with military credentials, pro-gun credentials.
sentences.zh: 而你拥有一个具备军事资历、亲枪资历的人。

sentences.en: Sounds like a pretty strong statewide candidate for Minnesota, which, by the way, Hillary only narrowly carried 2016.
sentences.zh: 听起来他是明尼苏达州的一个相当强有力的全州候选人，顺便说一句，希拉里在 2016 年仅以微弱优势赢下该州。

sentences.en: So that all sounds quite good.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切听起来很不错。

sentences.en: So why are we talking about this guy today?
sentences.zh: 那我们今天为什么在谈论这个人？

sentences.en: Well, because on the way to being the ideal candidate running for governor in a purplish state, Tim Walls has come up against a challenge.
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为在成为一个在偏紫州竞选州长的理想候选人的路上，蒂姆·沃尔斯遇到了一个挑战。

sentences.en: One of the credentials that made him so appealing to at least strategists in the Democratic Party,
sentences.zh: 那些让他对民主党策略师如此具有吸引力的资历之一——

sentences.en: his support for gun rights is now increasingly unacceptable to activists in the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 他对枪支权利的支持，现在越来越遭到民主党内部激进分子的不能接受。

sentences.en: The people around us failed us.
sentences.zh: 我们身边的人让我们失望了。

sentences.en: And if they continue to fail us, then they will no longer be in office because soon we will be given the ability to vote and we will vote them out.
sentences.zh: 如果他们继续让我们失望，那他们将不再任职，因为很快我们将获得投票权，我们将把他们投票赶下台。

sentences.en: And the people around us will vote them out.
sentences.zh: 我们周围的人会将他们投票赶下台。

sentences.en: And in the wake of the horrible shooting in Florida, he is facing real challenges from his left as he runs for the Democratic nomination for governor.
sentences.zh: 在佛罗里达州发生可怕的枪击事件之后，他在竞选民主党州长提名的过程中面临来自左翼的真正挑战。

sentences.en: Quickly has moved to detach himself from any connection to the NRA.
sentences.zh: 迅速采取行动，将自己与 NRA 的任何联系剥离。

sentences.en: He posted something of an apologia on Facebook talking about how his views have changed on guns.
sentences.zh: 他在 Facebook 上发表了一篇类似辩护声明的东西，谈到他对枪支的看法是如何改变的。

sentences.en: I will not and I've taken no money in this gubernatorial campaign.
sentences.zh: 我不会——而且我在这次州长竞选中没有拿任何钱。

sentences.en: I will not take any.
sentences.zh: 我不会拿任何钱。

sentences.en: I fully expect that the opposite will happen and a lot of NRA money will be spent against me.
sentences.zh: 我完全预计相反的情况会发生，会有很多 NRA 的资金用来反对我。

sentences.en: He is basically cutting all ties to the NRA and embracing gun control after this shooting because he recognizes that this has created a sort of clear and present danger in his
sentences.zh: 在这起枪击事件之后，他基本上切断了与 NRA 的所有联系，并拥护枪支管控，因为他认识到这在他竞选明尼苏达州州长提名的

sentences.en: march to the nomination for governor of Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 道路上造成了一种现实而紧迫的危险。

sentences.en: It should be expected that our legislative leaders should follow where the will of the people is.
sentences.zh: 我们的立法领导人应当顺应人民的意愿，这是理所当然的。

sentences.en: And if you haven't walked in a coffee shop over the last week and had 15 conversations on how this must end, you're not getting out.
sentences.zh: 如果你过去一周走进程咖啡馆，却没有听到 15 场关于这必须结束的对话，那你就是脱节了。

sentences.en: And I'm out.
sentences.zh: 而我没有脱节。

sentences.en: I'm hearing them.
sentences.zh: 我听到了他们的声音。

sentences.en: So why is Walls just now doing this?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么沃尔斯直到现在才这么做？

sentences.en: Why would he have ever been campaigning as a gun-loving Democrat if it would push away
sentences.zh: 如果这会把民主党选民推开，他为什么会曾经以一个热爱枪支的民主党人身份进行竞选？

sentences.en: Democratic voters?
sentences.zh: 民主党选民？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think this was the challenge for Democrats in the recent paSt.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这是过去民主党人面临的挑战。

sentences.en: The gun issue was not the motivating force for gun control advocates like it was for gun rights activists.
sentences.zh: 枪支问题并没有像对枪支权利积极分子那样，成为枪支管控倡导者的驱动力。

sentences.en: And why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: Well, I think that in the universe of the most ardent gun rights activists, that was their top issue.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为在最坚定的枪支权利活动人士的世界里，那是他们最重要的问题。

sentences.en: And they voted.
sentences.zh: 而且他们去投票了。

sentences.en: I mean, the NRA is a political force in American politics because they have an ability to galvanize
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，NRA 是美国政治中的一股政治力量，因为他们有能力激发

sentences.en: their supporters and drive them to the polls in state after state and election after election.
sentences.zh: 他们的支持者，并在一个又一个州、一场又一场选举中驱使他们前往投票站。

sentences.en: And Democrats, even if they were supportive of gun laws, didn't necessarily show up and vote on the issue in the same way.
sentences.zh: 而民主党人，即使他们支持枪支法律，也未必会以同样的方式在该问题上现身投票。

sentences.en: It was not the sort of central force for a lot of Democratic voters in general elections.
sentences.zh: 对于大选中的许多民主党选民来说，这并不是那种核心动力。

sentences.en: Could it also be, Jonathan, that because it is a motivating factor for Republicans, Democrats just haven't had any success with gun control?
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，是不是也因为这是一个激励共和党人的因素，民主党人在枪支管控方面一直没有取得任何成功？

sentences.en: The Republicans have been winning that fight.
sentences.zh: 共和党人一直在那场争斗中获胜。

sentences.en: So it's not really an issue worth campaigning on or voting on because no one is really expecting the Democrats to get anything done on it.
sentences.zh: 所以这其实不是一个值得拿来竞选或投票的议题，因为没有人真正期望民主党人能在这上面办成什么事。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a great point you make that the party had effectively waved the white flag, especially in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 是的，你说的很好，该党实际上已经挥白旗投降了，尤其是在参议院。

sentences.en: You know, it's pretty tough for Democrats to retain a Senate majority if they're not winning and holding a lot of rural states.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果民主党人不赢得并守住许多乡村州，他们很难保持参议院多数席位。

sentences.en: So what are we seeing, Jonathan, from Republicans?
sentences.zh: 那么乔纳森，我们从共和党人身上看到了什么？

sentences.en: They've so effectively blocked gun control for so many years now, and mass shootings haven't seemed to affect any of that.
sentences.zh: 多年来，他们非常有效地阻止了枪支管控，而大规模枪击事件似乎并没有对这一切产生任何影响。

sentences.en: If anything, the narrative has been that the mass shootings have strengthened the NRA and therefore the gun lobby and made the possibility of gun control seem even less likely.
sentences.zh: 如果有的话，这种叙事反而是大规模枪击事件壮大了 NRA，从而壮大了枪支游说集团，使得枪支管控的可能性看起来更加渺茫。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: What's different now is that the party is facing deep challenges in the midterms across a lot of suburban House districts and facing challenges in a lot of governor's races in
sentences.zh: 现在不同的是，该党在许多郊区众议院选区的中期选举中面临着严峻挑战，并在许多拥有大量城市和郊区的州的州长竞选中面临挑战。

sentences.en: states that have large swaths of cities and suburbs.
sentences.zh: 州。

sentences.en: You add to that fact a president who is uniquely unpopular in modern American history, and where he's unpopular, Michael, is the issue for the Republicans, right?
sentences.zh: 再加上这样一位在现代美国历史上极其不受欢迎的总统，而迈克尔，他不受欢迎的地方正是共和党人的问题所在，对吧？

sentences.en: But he's not unpopular in some of the more rural regions of the country where, you know, gun rights are treasured.
sentences.zh: 但他在该国一些更乡村的地区并不那么不受欢迎，你知道，在那些地方枪支权利是被珍视的。

sentences.en: He's deeply unpopular in cities and suburbs.
sentences.zh: 他在城市和郊区非常不受欢迎。

sentences.en: And so if you're a Republican and you are trying to figure out a way that you can create
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你是一名共和党人，并且你正在想方设法让自己与唐纳德·特朗普保持

sentences.en: some distance between yourself and Donald Trump with suburban voters, then you can criticize him.
sentences.zh: 一定距离以赢得郊区选民的支持，那么你可以批评他。

sentences.en: But you can also create space on policy issues.
sentences.zh: 但你也可以在政策议题上拉开空间。

sentences.en: And where is one obvious policy issue where you can say, look, I'm a different kind of Republican.
sentences.zh: 哪个是一个明显的政策议题，你可以借此说，看，我和别的共和党人不一样。

sentences.en: I support common sense gun restrictions.
sentences.zh: 我支持常识性的枪支限制。

sentences.en: Can you give us an example of a Republican dealing with this post-Parkland massacre?
sentences.zh: 你能给我们举一个应对帕克兰大屠杀之后的共和党人的例子吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.en: I'm Brian Mast, candidate for Congress here in Florida's 18th congressional district.
sentences.zh: 我是布赖恩·马斯特，这里是佛罗里达州第 18 国会选区的国会候选人。

sentences.en: There are some in Florida and near where the shooting happened, including Brian Mast, who's
sentences.zh: 在佛罗里达州以及枪击事件发生地附近的一些人，包括布赖恩·马斯特，他是一名

sentences.en: a combat veteran who lost both of his legs, who is a junior House Republican facing a potentially difficult re-election.
sentences.zh: 失去双腿的战斗老兵，也是一名面临潜在艰难连任的资历较浅的众议院共和党人。

sentences.en: I think most people who know me know that the Second Amendment is something that's very important to me.
sentences.zh: 我想了解我的人大多知道，宪法第二修正案对我来说是非常重要的东西。

sentences.en: Mast was a supporter of gun rights.
sentences.zh: 马斯特曾是枪支权利的支持者。

sentences.en: And I would encourage our lawmakers who are out there calling for gun confiscation to take a look at some of the horrific events occurring around the world.
sentences.zh: 我鼓励那些在外面呼吁没收枪支的我们的议员，去看一看世界各地发生的一些可怕事件。

sentences.en: They all could have been prevented.
sentences.zh: 这些本都可以避免。

sentences.en: Were there people present who were prepared to defend themselves?
sentences.zh: 当时现场有准备好保护自己的人吗？

sentences.en: He opposed restrictions on guns.
sentences.zh: 他反对枪支限制。

sentences.en: Look, I'm almost a lifelong NRA member.
sentences.zh: 听着，我几乎是终身 NRA 会员。

sentences.en: I know the pride of owning a weapon, of collecting, of going out there and hunting, you know, shooting
sentences.zh: 我知道拥有武器的骄傲，收藏的骄傲，出去狩猎，你知道，和家人一起

sentences.en: with family, doing clays, going out there and putting rounds on to steal with my kids.
sentences.zh: 射击、玩飞碟射击、出去和我的孩子们一起在钢靶上射击的骄傲。

sentences.en: I do it all the time.
sentences.zh: 我一直在这样做。

sentences.en: But we got to look at keeping our communities safe and protecting our children and protecting our schools.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须着眼于保持社区安全、保护我们的孩子以及保护我们的学校。

sentences.en: After this massacre, though, he has had a sort of change of heart.
sentences.zh: 然而，在这场大屠杀之后，他的想法发生了一种转变。

sentences.en: My community, my country is not safer with this unfettered access of anybody that's 18 years or older having access to this platform.
sentences.zh: 我的社区，我的国家，如果允许任何 18 岁或以上的人不受限制地接触这类平台，并不会变得更安全。

sentences.en: And is now calling for not just expanded background checks or raising the age of those who can buy weapons.
sentences.zh: 现在他不仅呼吁扩大背景调查或提高购枪者的年龄限制。

sentences.en: He actually is calling for the banning of some automatic sales.
sentences.zh: 他实际上呼吁禁止某些自动武器销售。

sentences.en: That's pretty significant from a Republican seeking office.
sentences.zh: 对于一个寻求公职的共和党人来说，这相当重要。

sentences.en: It sure is, and especially somebody who is seeking office in a state where most of the
sentences.zh: 确实如此，尤其是对于一个在大多数

sentences.en: Republicans are pretty supportive of gun rights.
sentences.zh: 共和党人都相当支持枪支权利的州寻求公职的人来说。

sentences.en: You know, you don't see a lot of Florida Republicans deviating from the NRA line.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你不会看到很多佛罗里达州的共和党人背离 NRA 的路线。

sentences.en: And who is Mast facing pressure from?
sentences.zh: 马斯特面临着来自谁的压力？

sentences.en: Well, the pressure Mast is facing is from his constituents because he is looking at a potentially competitive reelection this fall and has a district that straddles the Atlantic
sentences.zh: 嗯，马斯特面临的压力来自他的选民，因为他今年秋天将面临潜在竞争激烈的连任，并且他的选区横跨佛罗里达州的

sentences.en: coast in Florida.
sentences.zh: 大西洋海岸。

sentences.en: And, you know, this is middle class, upper middle class Floridians, a lot of them who have moved to this district from parts of the NortheaSt.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这里是中产阶层、上中产阶层的佛罗里达人，他们中有许多人是从东北部搬到这个选区的。

sentences.en: They just don't support the gun rights orthodoxy that folks in more rural districts and other parts of the South do.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不支持乡村选区和南部其他地方的人所信奉的枪支权利正统观念。

sentences.en: So the kind of suburban district you were talking about where there's some skepticism about the president and gun control might be the sort of thing that would win voters over.
sentences.zh: 所以你刚才谈到的那种对总统和枪支管控有些怀疑的郊区选区，可能正是那种能够赢得选民支持的类型。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: So, you know, this is the kind of district where the president's numbers were already unsteady because of the demographics there.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这就是那种由于当地人口结构原因，总统支持率本就摇摆不定的选区。

sentences.en: And if you're somebody like Brian Mast, you don't want this gun issue to be the final brick in the wall that walls you off, if you will, from those voters who are Trump skeptics.
sentences.zh: 如果你像布赖恩·马斯特一样，你绝不希望这个枪支问题成为筑起高墙的最后一块砖，把你与那些对特朗普持怀疑态度的选民隔离开来。

sentences.en: So is the takeaway of what's happening to Walls and Mast, a Democrat and a Republican who are now both walking back their positions on gun rights, is the takeaway that the whole
sentences.zh: 那么，发生在沃尔斯和马斯特身上的事情——一个民主党人和一个共和党人现在都在收回他们在枪支权利上的立场——其启示是否是整个

sentences.en: country is now leaning toward gun control?
sentences.zh: 国家现在都在向枪支管控倾斜？

sentences.en: No, that's not necessarily what's happening.
sentences.zh: 不，这并不一定是正在发生的事情。
